# Luna Pediatric Dentistry

> Luna Pediatric Dentistry is a specialized pediatric dental practice serving the greater Houston and Richmond, Texas area with expert children's dental care, sedation options, and emergency services.

Luna Pediatric Dentistry operates multiple locations across the Houston metropolitan area including Mission Bend, Sugar Land, Katy, and surrounding communities. The practice is led by Dr. Dzhuliya Servetnik and specializes in early childhood dental care, restorative treatments, sedation dentistry, and emergency dental services for children.

## Core Services

- [Early Dental Care](https://lunapediatricdentistry.com/early-dental-care): Early dental care and baby teeth care following ADA guidelines
- [Restorative Dental Services](https://lunapediatricdentistry.com/restorative-dental-services): Restorative services: fillings, crowns, pulpotomy, and decay treatment
- [Emergency Dental Services](https://lunapediatricdentistry.com/emergency-dental-services): Emergency dental services and guidance for dental emergencies
- [Pediatric Sedation Dentistry](https://lunapediatricdentistry.com/sedation-dentistry-for-children): Pediatric anesthesia options: nitrous oxide, IV, and oral sedation
